title: Image generation gets past two avoidable failures
summary:
A debugging-heavy day for image and vision requests, with steadier Pollen rate limits and clearer terms.

Two PRs addressed the same missing import that broke Kontext generation and editing. A separate fix removed Nanobanana’s hardcoded 25-second request timeout, so slower generations—especially those using reference images—no longer fail solely because they cross that mark.

Vision request validation now accepts image_url content without a detail field. Prompt filter results can also omit content_filter_results without triggering a schema error.

The +$5 Pollen button now opens checkout; the other bundle buttons remain disabled. Publishable-key rate limits now retain bucket state across restarts, calculate refill waits consistently, and distinguish exhausted buckets from concurrent-request limits in their 429 responses.
